headline: 紀錄片NAZA紐約首映惹議
context: 紀錄片《NAZA》在紐約首映，導演出面回應外界威脅。這部得獎紀錄片主張，以色列在加薩對巴勒斯坦人存在系統性殺戮，導演在首映會上為片中論點辯護，並提到收到以色列官員的威脅。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor defend findings on Israel’s killing of Palestinians amid threats from Israeli officials The film-makers behind NAZA , the award-winning documentary on Israel’s systemic mass killing of Palestinians in Gaza, defended their findings at the film’s North American premiere in New York on Saturday, amid protests in Israel and escalating threats from Israeli officials to strip them of their citizenship. The critically acclaimed film , directed by Oscar-winning film-makers Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor and produced by the Guardian, features the testimony of 24 anonymized Israeli soldiers and intelligence officers involved in the surveillance and remote killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza, who describe the AI-powered systems used to select their targets. The project takes its name from an acronym used euphemistically by Israeli intelligence to indicate how many civilians it expects to die in an airstrike , which are often conducted at night in private homes, killing many family members, including children, at once. thread_text:
紀錄片NAZA紐約首映惹議

紀錄片《NAZA》在紐約舉行首映，兩位導演尤瓦爾·亞伯拉罕（Yuval Abraham）與瑞秋·佐爾（Rachel Szor）當場回應了外界威脅。這部得獎紀錄片，主張以色列在加薩對巴勒斯坦人進行系統性殺戮，兩位導演也在首映會上，為片中論述辯護。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 9 月 27 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
紀錄片《NAZA》在紐約舉行首映，兩位導演尤瓦爾·亞伯拉罕與瑞秋·佐爾當場回應了外界威脅。這部得獎紀錄片，主張以色列在加薩對巴勒斯坦人進行系統性殺戮，兩位導演也在首映會上為片中論述辯護，同時提到自己因為這部片，收到了以色列官員的威脅。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 9 月 27 日 發佈的報導。
voice_text: 紀錄片《NAZA》在紐約舉行首映，兩位導演當場回應了外界的威脅。這部得獎紀錄片，主張以色列在加薩對巴勒斯坦人進行系統性殺戮。導演尤瓦爾與瑞秋，在首映會上為片中的論述辯護，同時也提到自己收到以色列官員的威脅。
